# Multi-mass shaft test system: a SynchronousSubtransientSP machine whose rotor is
# a four-mass torsional shaft (HP -- IP -- LP -- GEN) instead of a single rigid
# mass. The generator mass keeps the canonical delta/omega; HP/IP/LP add their own
# angle/speed states and share the mechanical power by F_*. Topology mirrors
# pss_on / sp_ground. See docs/algebraic_equations_design.md (shaft strategy).
